threads.body: `ubuntu-slim` is not a standard GitHub-hosted runner label (supported labels are typically `ubuntu-latest`, `ubuntu-24.04`, `ubuntu-22.04`, etc.). If this repo/org doesn’t have a self-hosted runner labeled `ubuntu-slim`, this job will remain queued and never start. If the intent is to use a GitHub-hosted runner, switch back to a supported Ubuntu runner label; if the intent is to target a self-hosted runner, consider using an explicit label set (e.g., `runs-on: [self-hosted, ubuntu-slim]`) and ensure that label exists.
